children: European stocks are declining as markets around the world catch up with yesterday's panic selling in U.S. markets. But the moves are muted compared with the big swings seen in South Korea and other Asian markets overnight.
Every name except five in the Stoxx 50 is down...

But the exceptions include key European AI names: electric-gear suppliers and Siemens Energy and chip-manufacturing equipment maker ASML. That could point to a rebound for the data-center complex in the U.S. session.
The Swiss franc reached a five-month high against the euro as investors sought safe assets.
German bund yields tracked Treasury yields lower.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
